platform_mcp_weibo_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WEIBO_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_weibo_access_token.description: Weibo OAuth2 access_token, sent as the access_token parameter ('采用OAuth授权方式为必填参数'). For your own account use the developer authorization of your app (开发者授权, valid 5 years); ordinary user authorizations last 1 or 30 days depending on the app's level and cannot be refreshed server-side (refresh tokens exist only for the official mobile SDK) (https://open.weibo.com/wiki/%E6%8E%88%E6%9D%83%E6%9C%BA%E5%88%B6%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E).

platform_mcp_weibo_user_ip.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WEIBO_USER_IP
platform_mcp_weibo_user_ip.description: Real public IP of the operating user, sent as rip on statuses/share ('开发者上报的操作用户真实IP，形如：211.156.0.1').

tools.name: me
tools.description: account/get_uid returns {uid} of the authorized user (not counted against the rate limit).

tools.name: publish_text
tools.description: PUBLISHES a public Weibo through statuses/share ('第三方分享一条链接到微博'): `text` must be at most 140 Chinese characters, may not contain #话题词#, and MUST contain at least one URL on the app's registered safe domain (我的应用 > 应用信息 > 安全域名), otherwise Weibo rejects it. rip is config user_ip. No picture is sent (pic is a multipart upload). `id` is idstr; `reply_to` is ignored.

tools.name: read_comments
tools.description: comments/show?id={weibo id}&page&count returns {comments[{id, idstr, text, created_at ('Wed Jun 01 00:50:25 +0800 2011'), user{screen_name}, status}], total_number}.

tools.name: read_mentions
tools.description: statuses/mentions (@我的微博): `since` is a Weibo id (since_id), not a date. Weibo returns only posts by users who have also authorized this app ('只返回授权用户的微博'), so the list is partial.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: statuses/destroy deletes one of the account's own Weibo posts ('只能删除自己发布的微博') and returns the deleted status.

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: statuses/count?ids= returns [{id, comments, reposts}] (counts as strings) for the one post id sent; likes and views are not part of this endpoint.
